claims.originating_goal: The repository test suite could not run at all: pytest aborted during collection, so zero of its guards executed and their failures were invisible. Two test files caused it. One imported a checker wrapper that execs its implementation with __name__ == "__main__", so importing raised SystemExit out of collection. The other carried an escaped newline that made it unparseable, and its assertions were bare module-level statements, so any drifted marker aborted collection rather than failing a test. Restore collection without touching the claimed wrapper scripts.
claims.claim_expires_when: Release once the suite collects and runs end to end. This claim does not cover repairing the failures that become visible as a result; those are separate drift with their own owners.
expected_evidence: pytest collects and runs the suite instead of aborting
every assertion in the repaired files preserved exactly, verified by AST comparison
checker scripts still exit with their own status when run directly
